enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Close eyes. Pull the blanket up over the shoulders. Turn the body onto the left side. Bend the right arm under the pillow. Straighten the legs. Hold the position. Turn the body onto the back. Move the left arm onto the chest. Turn the head to the right. Extend both legs. Turn the body onto the right side. Tuck the left hand under the cheek. Pull the blanket up to the chin. Bend the knees slightly. Hold the position. Shift the left leg forward. Turn the body onto the back again. Keep the eyes closed and remain still.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Push the blanket down with both hands. Sit up on the edge of the bed. Place both feet on the floor. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom door. Push the door open. Step inside. Raise the right hand and press the light switch. Walk to the sink. Turn the tap handle to the left. Put both hands under the water. Cup water in the palms. Splash water onto the face. Rub the face with both hands. Turn off the tap. Reach for the towel on the rail. Wipe the face with the towel. Hang the towel back on the rail. Pick up the toothbrush from the holder. Pick up the toothpaste tube. Unscrew the cap. Squeeze paste onto the bristles. Put the cap back on. Put the tube down. Turn on the tap. Wet the toothbrush under the water. Lift the brush to the mouth. Brush the upper teeth. Brush the lower teeth. Spit into the sink. Rinse the mouth with water. Spit again. Rinse the brush under the water. Put the brush back in the holder. Turn off the tap. Press the light switch off. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, preparing a packed lunch
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Press the light switch on. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the milk carton. Take out the egg carton. Take out the bread bag. Close the refrigerator door. Put the items on the counter. Open the cupboard door. Take out a bowl. Close the cupboard door. Place the bowl on the counter. Open the bread bag. Take out two slices of bread. Put them on a plate. Crack two eggs into the bowl. Beat the eggs with a fork. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Press the power button. Pour oil into the pan. Pour the beaten eggs into the pan. Stir the eggs with a spatula. Turn off the induction cooker. Slide the eggs onto the plate. Pick up the plate and carry it to the table. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the fork. Eat the eggs and bread. Lift the cup and drink the milk. Stand up. Carry the plate and cup to the sink. Rinse the plate under the tap. Place the plate in the sink. Open the refrigerator. Take out the lunchbox container. Take out the cooked rice and vegetables. Close the refrigerator. Spoon rice into the lunchbox. Add vegetables. Close the lid. Place the lunchbox on the counter. Wipe the counter with a cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes and packing work bag and essentials
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Open the wardrobe door. Take out the work uniform. Take out a pair of socks. Lay the clothes on the bed. Take off the pajama top. Take off the pajama bottoms. Put on the work shirt. Button the shirt. Put on the trousers. Pull up the zipper. Fasten the belt. Sit on the bed. Put on the socks. Put on the shoes. Tie the shoelaces. Stand up. Walk to the desk. Pick up the ID badge. Clip the badge onto the shirt pocket. Pick up the stethoscope from the desk. Coil the stethoscope. Place it into the work bag. Pick up the phone from the nightstand. Place the phone into the bag. Pick up the charger. Place the charger into the bag. Pick up the house keys. Place the keys into the bag. Walk to the kitchen. Pick up the lunchbox. Return to Bedroom 1. Place the lunchbox into the work bag. Pull the zipper closed. Lift the bag onto the shoulder. Walk out of the bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the front door. Pull the door closed. Lock the door with the key. Put the key into the bag. Walk along the sidewalk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Look at the phone screen. Check the time. Put the phone back into the pocket. Step forward as the bus arrives. Board the bus. Tap the transit card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit on an empty seat. Place the work bag on the lap. Hold the handrail with the right hand. Look out of the window. Stand up as the stop approaches. Walk to the rear door. Step off the bus. Walk along the sidewalk to the hospital entrance. Push the glass door open. Step into the lobby. Walk to the elevator. Press the up button. Step into the elevator. Press the floor button. Step out of the elevator. Walk to the ward. Open the staff room door. Place the bag into the locker. Close the locker door. Walk to the nurse station.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional: patient rounds, assessments and clinical documentation
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the patient list from the desk. Walk to Room 1. Push the door open. Greet the patient. Say 'Good morning, how are you feeling today?' Pick up the blood pressure cuff. Wrap the cuff around the patient's arm. Press the start button. Read the monitor. Write the reading on the chart. Remove the cuff. Place the cuff back on the cart. Pick up the thermometer. Place it under the patient's tongue. Remove it. Read the display. Record the temperature. Pick up the stethoscope. Place the earpieces in the ears. Place the chest piece on the patient's chest. Listen to the heartbeat. Remove the stethoscope. Hang it around the neck. Walk to the next bed. Pull the curtain aside. Help the patient sit up. Adjust the pillow behind the back. Check the IV line. Adjust the drip rate. Write notes on the chart. Walk back to the nurse station. Sit at the computer. Type the assessment notes into the system. Save the record. Pick up the medication cart. Push the cart down the corridor.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating the packed lunch
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the staff break room. Push the door open. Walk to the locker. Open the locker door. Take out the lunchbox. Close the locker door. Walk to the table. Place the lunchbox on the table. Pull out the chair. Sit down on the chair. Open the lunchbox lid. Pick up the fork. Eat the rice and vegetables. Lift the water bottle. Unscrew the cap. Drink water. Screw the cap back on. Wipe the mouth with a napkin. Close the lunchbox lid. Stand up. Push the chair back under the table. Walk to the sink. Rinse the fork under the tap. Place the fork into the lunchbox. Walk to the locker. Open the locker door. Place the lunchbox inside. Close the locker door. Walk back to the ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical duties: patient care, medication administration and handover preparation
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the medication room. Open the medication cabinet. Take out the medication cups. Read the medication chart. Place pills into the cups. Close the cabinet door. Place the cups on the cart. Push the cart to Room 1. Pick up a cup. Hand the cup to the patient. Hand a glass of water to the patient. Wait for the patient to swallow. Take back the glass. Move to the next bed. Check the patient's wristband. Compare the name on the chart. Administer the medication. Record the dose on the chart. Push the cart back to the medication room. Wash hands at the sink. Dry hands with paper towels. Walk to the nurse station. Sit at the computer. Type the medication records. Open the handover template. Type the shift summary. Save the document. Print the handover sheet. Pick up the sheet from the printer. Walk to the incoming shift nurse. Hand over the printed sheet. Report the patient status verbally.

Walk to the staff room. Open the locker door. Take out the work bag. Close the locker door. Lift the bag onto the shoulder. Walk out of the ward. Walk to the elevator. Press the down button. Step into the elevator. Press the ground floor button. Step out of the elevator. Walk across the lobby. Push the glass door open. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take the phone out of the pocket. Check the time. Put the phone back. Board the bus as it arrives. Tap the transit card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit on an empty seat. Place the bag on the lap. Rest the head against the window frame. Stand up at the stop. Walk to the rear door. Step off the bus. Walk along the sidewalk to the house. Take the key out of the bag. Insert the key into the lock. Turn the key. Push the front door open. Step inside. Close the door behind. Lock the door.

Walk into the kitchen. Press the light switch on. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables. Take out the chicken. Take out the tofu. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Walk to the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the vegetables under the water. Turn off the tap. Place the vegetables on the cutting board. Pick up the knife. Chop the vegetables into pieces. Place the pieces into a bowl. Cut the chicken into pieces. Place them on a plate. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Press the power button. Pour oil into the pan. Add the chicken pieces. Stir with the spatula. Add the vegetables. Add salt from the container. Stir again. Press the power button off. Pick up the plate. Carry the plate to the table. Pick up a bowl. Spoon rice into the bowl. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the chopsticks. Eat the rice, chicken and vegetables. Lift the cup and drink water. Stand up. Carry the plate and bowl to the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up after dinner and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on the tap. Rinse the plate under the water. Pick up the sponge. Add dish soap to the sponge. Scrub the plate. Scrub the bowl. Scrub the pan. Rinse the plate under the water. Rinse the bowl. Rinse the pan. Turn off the tap. Open the dishwasher door. Pull out the lower rack. Place the plates into the rack. Place the bowls into the rack. Place the pan into the rack. Place the chopsticks into the basket. Push the lower rack in. Pull out the upper rack. Place the cups upside down into the rack. Push the upper rack in. Pick up the detergent box. Open the lid. Pour detergent into the dispenser. Close the lid. Close the dishwasher door. Press the start button. Wipe the counter with the cloth. Wipe the table with the cloth. Rinse the cloth under the tap. Wring the cloth out. Hang the cloth on the hook.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing laundry in the washing machine and taking a quick shower
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Press the light switch on. Walk to the bedroom and pick up the laundry basket. Carry the basket back to the bathroom. Open the washing machine door. Take the clothes out of the basket. Put the clothes into the drum. Close the washing machine door. Pull out the detergent drawer. Pour detergent into the drawer. Push the drawer back in. Press the power button. Turn the dial to the wash program. Press the start button. Walk to the shower area. Turn the water heater switch on. Turn the shower tap to the left. Hold the hand under the water. Step under the shower. Wet the body. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap over the body. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Open the cap. Pour shampoo into the palm. Rub the shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair under the water. Turn the shower tap to the right. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel from the rail. Wipe the body with the towel. Wrap the towel around the hair. Open the bathroom door. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing for the severe storm: charging phone and computer, checking torches and supplies
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Press the light switch on. Pick up the phone from the table. Walk to the power outlet. Plug the charger into the outlet. Plug the cable into the phone. Place the phone on the table. Pick up the laptop from the sofa. Plug the laptop charger into the outlet. Plug the cable into the laptop. Place the laptop on the table. Walk to the cabinet. Open the cabinet door. Take out the torch. Press the torch button. Shine the torch at the floor. Press the button off. Place the torch on the table. Take out the second torch. Press the button. Shine it on the wall. Press the button off. Place it on the table. Open the drawer. Take out the batteries. Place the batteries on the table. Close the drawer. Walk to the kitchen. Open the refrigerator. Take out two bottles of water. Walk back to the living room. Place the bottles on the table. Pick up the phone and check the charging icon. Push the window latch closed. Pull the window shut.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the sofa. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the remote control from the cushion. Press the power button. Aim the remote at the TV. Press the channel button. Place the remote on the cushion. Lean back against the sofa. Cross the legs. Pick up the phone from the table. Slide the screen with the thumb. Place the phone back on the table. Pull the blanket over the legs. Adjust the cushion behind the back. Watch the TV screen. Pick up the remote. Press the volume button. Place the remote down. Stand up. Walk to the kitchen. Open the refrigerator. Take out a bottle of water. Close the refrigerator. Walk back to the sofa. Sit down. Drink water from the bottle. Place the bottle on the table.

Walk into the bathroom. Press the light switch on. Walk to the sink. Turn on the tap. Wet the hands under the water. Pick up the facial cleanser. Open the cap. Squeeze cleanser into the palm. Rub the palms together. Apply the foam to the face. Rub the face in circles. Rinse the face under the water. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face. Hang the towel on the rail. Pick up the toothbrush. Pick up the toothpaste. Squeeze paste onto the bristles. Turn on the tap. Wet the brush. Brush the teeth. Spit into the sink. Rinse the mouth. Turn off the tap. Put the brush back in the holder. Turn on the shower tap. Wash the feet under the water. Turn off the tap. Dry the feet with the towel. Press the light switch off. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down in bed, reading on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Press the light switch on. Pick up the phone from the desk. Unplug the charging cable from the phone. Walk to the bed. Pull the blanket down. Sit on the edge of the bed. Lie down on the back. Pull the blanket up over the legs. Hold the phone above the face. Press the power button on the phone. Slide the screen. Open the reading app. Scroll down the page with the thumb. Read the text on the screen. Scroll to the next page. Tap the screen. Scroll again. Press the side button to lock the phone. Place the phone on the nightstand. Turn the body onto the right side. Pull the blanket up to the chest. Reach out the right hand. Press the light switch off. Close the eyes.

Lie still on the bed. Close the eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn the body onto the left side. Bend the right knee. Pull the blanket over the shoulder. Extend the left arm under the pillow. Hold the position. Turn the body onto the back. Place both hands on the chest. Turn the head to the left. Straighten the legs. Turn the body onto the right side. Tuck the left hand under the cheek. Pull the blanket up to the chin. Shift the left leg forward. Remain still. Keep the eyes closed and continue sleeping.
